Hard cut: LSE two-bar chart with surprised head replaced by an empty white canvas with a single full-body smiling stick figure at centre, one arm raised.
Centre stick figure's arm pose changes (one arm raised and bent -> both arms bent outward, legs slightly changed); face unchanged smile. Same figure.
Stick figure removed and a black SpaceX wordmark appears at upper centre-left on an otherwise empty white canvas.
Dark news-search-result card (source badge, headline about SpaceX posting nearly $5 billion loss in 2025, snippet, thumbnail) appears under the wordmark in one frame.
Hard cut: wordmark, news card, red ellipse and 'ouch' replaced by a full-width titled bar chart 'SpaceX IPO vs. The Biggest Companies on Earth' (16 company rows, red SpaceX bar).
Hard cut: bar chart replaced by a smiling stick figure at centre with two tiny shoulder characters (haloed angel at left, red-horned devil at right) on white.
Punch-in: figure, angel and devil jump to roughly 2x scale (head fills upper centre) and a pointing fist appears at lower centre; single-frame jump, no tween.
Hard cut at f730 from scaled figure with angel/devil to a small '401K' paper-document icon at centre (red title, scribble lines), which then scales up steadily through f784 and beyond.
Hard cut: large plain 401K document replaced by a smaller character-version of the document with eyes, stick legs, arm and a green banknote held out to the right.
Hard cut: document character and speech bubble replaced by a large exchange logo (teal slashes mark plus black wordmark 'Nasdaq') filling the centre.
Hard cut: logo, scroll and caption replaced by a lone smiling stick figure at centre on white, hands on hips.
Stick figure's smile becomes a flat skeptical mouth with raised eyebrow and one arm lifts; same figure, same position.
Hard cut: stick figure removed, black SpaceX wordmark appears at left-centre on empty white canvas.
Speech bubble 'Yes I'm worth that much, pinky promise.' appears to the right of the wordmark.

Question speech bubble disappears at upper left; interviewer's arm now reaches mic toward the hoodie character.
Hoodie character replaced by a new bow-tie character (brown skin, curly hair) at centre; bubble text changes to 'Things to go to Mars!'. Interviewer stays at left.
Interviewer and speech bubble removed; hoodie character returns at left of the bow-tie character, forming a clean two-character pair on white.

Hard cut: the three-box stack replaced by a single large tilted cartoon rocket with flame at upper centre.

Red-X rocket drawing (centre) replaced by black wide-letter company wordmark plus 'presents...' text top-left and a narrow western-film poster strip starting to reveal at centre-right on white canvas.

Whole frame replaced: poster and wordmark vanish, a centred black-outline stick figure with peach round head, spiky hair, smile and hands-on-hips appears. Machine class (large partial) understates full-frame cut.
Hard cut at f1805 from frowning stick figure to poster at left and grey shipping box at right; poster then narrows leftward to a thin strip by f1814. Cut plus exit.
